g.aria-label: Subtitle text 'UK primary balance vs previous-year debt, by era (peacetime years). Upward-sloping = debt-stabilising; the slope flattens and turns negative after the 1970s.'

text.tspan: UK primary balance vs previous-year debt, by era (peacetime years).
Upward-sloping = debt-stabilising; the slope flattens and turns negative after the 1970s.
